rows.label: Withholding on payments to contractors
rows.value: None in general: no income tax, Social Security or Medicare is withheld from independent contractors
rows.source_title: IRS: Independent contractor (self-employed) or employee? (page last reviewed 19 May 2026)

rows.section: Contractor rules: worker classification, information returns and backup withholding
rows.label: Relief for misclassification
rows.value: Section 530 relief where the business had a reasonable basis and filed consistent information returns (Pub. 1976)
rows.source_title: IRS: Independent contractor (self-employed) or employee? (page last reviewed 19 May 2026)

rows.section: Contractor rules: worker classification, information returns and backup withholding
rows.label: Form 1099-NEC: report nonemployee compensation of at least
rows.note: Per payee per year, from 2026 (was $600); may be indexed from 2027
rows.source_title: IRS: Instructions for Forms 1099-MISC and 1099-NEC (Rev. December 2026)

rows.section: Contractor rules: worker classification, information returns and backup withholding
rows.label: Form 1099-MISC: gross proceeds paid to an attorney of at least
rows.source_title: IRS: Instructions for Forms 1099-MISC and 1099-NEC (Rev. December 2026)

rows.section: Contractor rules: worker classification, information returns and backup withholding
rows.label: Form 1099-K (payment apps and online marketplaces)
rows.value: Over $20,000 in more than 200 transactions a year
rows.source_title: IRS: Understanding your Form 1099-K (page last reviewed 13 Nov 2026)

rows.section: Contractor rules: worker classification, information returns and backup withholding
rows.label: Backup withholding rate
rows.note: When the payee gives no correct taxpayer identification number (Form W-9), among other cases
rows.source_title: IRS: Backup withholding (page last reviewed 10 Oct 2026)

rows.section: Contractor rules: worker classification, information returns and backup withholding
rows.label: Nonresident alien contractors: withholding on pay for independent personal services
rows.note: Unless a treaty exemption is claimed on Form 8233 or a withholding agreement applies
rows.source_title: IRS: Publication 515 (2026), Withholding of Tax on Nonresident Aliens and Foreign Entities: Pay for independent personal services

rows.section: Simplified or presumptive regime for the self-employed
rows.label: Simplified, flat-rate or presumptive regime
rows.value: None: sole proprietors report actual net profit on Schedule C and pay income tax at the ordinary rates plus self-employment tax
rows.source_title: IRS: Sole proprietorships (page last reviewed 28 Jun 2026)

rows.section: Simplified or presumptive regime for the self-employed
rows.label: Qualified business income (QBI) deduction (section 199A)
rows.note: A deduction of up to 20% of qualified business income from actual profit, not a separate regime
rows.source_title: IRS: Qualified business income deduction (page last reviewed 30 Oct 2026)

rows.section: Simplified or presumptive regime for the self-employed
rows.label: QBI threshold: married filing jointly
rows.note: Limits phase in up to $553,500
rows.source_title: IRS: Rev. Proc. 2025-32, sections 2.12 and 3.26 (Qualified Business Income, taxable years beginning in 2026)

rows.section: Simplified or presumptive regime for the self-employed
rows.label: QBI threshold: married filing separately
rows.note: Limits phase in up to $276,775
rows.source_title: IRS: Rev. Proc. 2025-32, sections 2.12 and 3.26 (Qualified Business Income, taxable years beginning in 2026)

rows.section: Simplified or presumptive regime for the self-employed
rows.label: QBI threshold: all other returns
rows.note: Limits phase in up to $276,750
rows.source_title: IRS: Rev. Proc. 2025-32, sections 2.12 and 3.26 (Qualified Business Income, taxable years beginning in 2026)

rows.section: Simplified or presumptive regime for the self-employed
rows.label: Minimum QBI deduction
rows.note: For at least $1,000 of QBI from an active business, from 2026
rows.source_title: IRS: Rev. Proc. 2025-32, sections 2.12 and 3.26 (Qualified Business Income, taxable years beginning in 2026)

rows.section: Simplified or presumptive regime for the self-employed
rows.label: Cash method allowed for corporations and partnerships with average gross receipts up to
rows.note: Gross receipts test of section 448(c), 3 prior years
rows.source_title: IRS: Rev. Proc. 2025-32, section 3.30 (Limitation on Use of Cash Method of Accounting)

rows.section: Nonresident aliens: tax on employment income
rows.label: Residence test (substantial presence)
rows.value: Present at least 31 days in the year and 183 days over 3 years, counting all days this year, 1/3 of last year's and 1/6 of the year before
rows.source_title: IRS: Publication 519, U.S. Tax Guide for Aliens (for use in preparing 2025 returns), chapter 1: Substantial Presence Test

rows.section: Nonresident aliens: tax on employment income
rows.label: Wages
rows.value: Taxed at the same graduated rates as residents (effectively connected income)
rows.source_title: IRS: Publication 519, U.S. Tax Guide for Aliens (for use in preparing 2025 returns), chapters 4, 5 and 8; Publication 515 (2026)

rows.section: Nonresident aliens: tax on employment income
rows.label: Income not effectively connected with a US business (flat rate, or lower treaty rate)
rows.source_title: IRS: Publication 519, U.S. Tax Guide for Aliens (for use in preparing 2025 returns), chapters 4, 5 and 8; Publication 515 (2026)

rows.section: Nonresident aliens: tax on employment income
rows.label: Standard deduction
rows.value: Not allowed (except students and business apprentices from India under the treaty)
rows.source_title: IRS: Publication 519, U.S. Tax Guide for Aliens (for use in preparing 2025 returns), chapters 4, 5 and 8; Publication 515 (2026)

rows.section: Nonresident aliens: tax on employment income
rows.label: Filing status
rows.value: Married nonresident aliens generally file as married filing separately; Form 1040-NR
rows.source_title: IRS: Publication 519, U.S. Tax Guide for Aliens (for use in preparing 2025 returns), chapters 4, 5 and 8; Publication 515 (2026)

rows.section: Nonresident aliens: tax on employment income
rows.label: Withholding: amount added to annual wages (Form W-4 for 2020 or later)
rows.note: Weekly $309.6, monthly $1,341.7; used only to figure withholding
rows.source_title: IRS: Publication 15-T (2026), Federal Income Tax Withholding Methods: Withholding Adjustment for Nonresident Alien Employees

rows.section: Nonresident aliens: tax on employment income
rows.label: Withholding: amount added to annual wages (Form W-4 before 2020)
rows.source_title: IRS: Publication 15-T (2026), Federal Income Tax Withholding Methods: Withholding Adjustment for Nonresident Alien Employees

rows.section: Nonresident aliens: tax on employment income
rows.label: Social Security and Medicare
rows.value: Withheld as for residents, except F, J, M and Q visa holders working for the purpose of their visa
rows.source_title: IRS: Publication 519, U.S. Tax Guide for Aliens (for use in preparing 2025 returns), chapters 4, 5 and 8; Publication 515 (2026)

rows.section: Nonresident aliens: tax on employment income
rows.label: Treaty relief
rows.value: Exemption from withholding on compensation claimed on Form 8233, accepted by the employer and sent to the IRS within 5 days
rows.source_title: IRS: Publication 515 (2026), Pay for Personal Services Performed: Form 8233

rows.section: Property tax
rows.label: Levied by
rows.value: State and local governments: rates are set locally on assessed value
rows.source_title: IRS: Topic no. 503, Deductible taxes (page last reviewed 9 Nov 2026)

rows.section: Property tax
rows.label: Base
rows.value: Real property, at a uniform rate across the jurisdiction; some states and localities also tax personal property such as a boat or car
rows.source_title: IRS: Topic no. 503, Deductible taxes (page last reviewed 9 Nov 2026)

rows.section: Property tax
rows.label: State rules and limits
rows.value: Assessment rules, caps and exemptions are set by each state: see the state pages
rows.source_title: IRS: Topic no. 503, Deductible taxes (page last reviewed 9 Nov 2026)

rows.section: Property tax
rows.label: Federal deduction limit for state and local taxes, incl. property tax (SALT)
rows.note: $20,200 married filing separately
rows.source_title: IRS: Publication 505 (2026), Tax Withholding and Estimated Tax: What's New, State and local tax deduction increased

rows.section: Property tax
rows.label: SALT limit reduced when modified AGI exceeds
rows.note: $252,500 married filing separately; not below $10,000 ($5,000)
rows.source_title: IRS: Publication 505 (2026), Tax Withholding and Estimated Tax: What's New, State and local tax deduction increased

rows.section: Real estate transfer tax
rows.label: Levied by
rows.value: States, counties and cities: rates, who pays and exemptions are on the state pages
rows.source_title: IRS: Topic no. 503, Deductible taxes (page last reviewed 9 Nov 2026): Nondeductible taxes

rows.section: Real estate transfer tax
rows.label: Federal income tax
rows.value: Not deductible as a tax on Schedule A (itemized deductions)
rows.source_title: IRS: Topic no. 503, Deductible taxes (page last reviewed 9 Nov 2026): Nondeductible taxes

rows.section: Business, contractor, non-resident and property taxes: summary
rows.label: Corporate income tax and corporate alternative minimum tax [national; state taxes on the state pages]
rows.value: 21% flat; CAMT 15% of financial statement income above $1,000,000,000 average. Paid by C corporations. IRC sections 11, 55, 59(k)
rows.note: One row per tax added on 2026-11-13 (corporate, self-employment, contractor, non-resident, property and transfer taxes). Each row has its own source.
rows.source_title: IRS: Instructions for Form 1120 (2025), Schedule J, line 1a

rows.section: Business, contractor, non-resident and property taxes: summary
rows.label: Branch profits tax [national]
rows.value: 30% of the dividend equivalent amount, or the treaty rate. Paid by foreign corporations with a US business. IRC section 884
rows.note: One row per tax added on 2026-11-13 (corporate, self-employment, contractor, non-resident, property and transfer taxes). Each row has its own source.
rows.source_title: IRS: Instructions for Form 1120-F (2025), Section III: Branch Profits Tax and Tax on Excess Interest

rows.section: Business, contractor, non-resident and property taxes: summary
rows.label: Self-employed contributions: self-employment tax [national]
rows.value: 15.3% on 92.35% of net profit (Social Security part up to $184,500), plus 0.9% above the Additional Medicare thresholds. Paid by the self-employed. IRC sections 1401, 1402
rows.note: One row per tax added on 2026-11-13 (corporate, self-employment, contractor, non-resident, property and transfer taxes). Each row has its own source.
rows.source_title: IRS: Self-employment tax (Social Security and Medicare taxes) (page last reviewed 30 Oct 2026)

rows.section: Business, contractor, non-resident and property taxes: summary
rows.label: Contractor rules and backup withholding [national]
rows.value: Common-law test; Form 1099-NEC from $2,000; backup withholding 24%. Payers report; contractors pay their own tax. IRC sections 3406, 6041
rows.note: One row per tax added on 2026-11-13 (corporate, self-employment, contractor, non-resident, property and transfer taxes). Each row has its own source.
rows.source_title: IRS: Independent contractor (self-employed) or employee? (page last reviewed 19 May 2026)

rows.section: Business, contractor, non-resident and property taxes: summary
rows.label: Simplified or presumptive regime for the self-employed [national]
rows.value: None: profit is taxed at the ordinary rates (the QBI deduction of up to 20% is a deduction, not a regime)
rows.note: One row per tax added on 2026-11-13 (corporate, self-employment, contractor, non-resident, property and transfer taxes). Each row has its own source.
rows.source_title: IRS: Sole proprietorships (page last reviewed 28 Jun 2026)

rows.section: Business, contractor, non-resident and property taxes: summary
rows.label: Non-resident aliens: tax on employment income [national]
rows.value: Graduated rates on wages, no standard deduction, withholding adjusted under Pub. 15-T. Paid by nonresident alien employees. IRC sections 871(b), 7701(b)
rows.note: One row per tax added on 2026-11-13 (corporate, self-employment, contractor, non-resident, property and transfer taxes). Each row has its own source.
rows.source_title: IRS: Publication 519, U.S. Tax Guide for Aliens (for use in preparing 2025 returns), chapters 4, 5 and 8; Publication 515 (2026)

rows.section: Business, contractor, non-resident and property taxes: summary
rows.label: Property tax [state and local]
rows.value: Rates set locally on assessed value; state rules on the state pages. Paid by property owners
rows.note: One row per tax added on 2026-11-13 (corporate, self-employment, contractor, non-resident, property and transfer taxes). Each row has its own source.
rows.source_title: IRS: Topic no. 503, Deductible taxes (page last reviewed 9 Nov 2026)

rows.section: Business, contractor, non-resident and property taxes: summary
rows.label: Real estate transfer tax [state and local]
rows.value: Set by states, counties and cities (none in some states); rates on the state pages. Paid by the seller or the buyer as each state provides
rows.note: One row per tax added on 2026-11-13 (corporate, self-employment, contractor, non-resident, property and transfer taxes). Each row has its own source.
rows.source_title: IRS: Topic no. 503, Deductible taxes (page last reviewed 9 Nov 2026): Nondeductible taxes
